title: Tenant residency contractor and evidence bundler
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Problem: Customers need a clear, auditable flow to declare tenant data residency for Hosted API endpoints, lock regions for traffic, set retention windows per-tenant, and generate a legally exportable evidence bundle for audits. Current controls are fragmented across Console settings, internal compliance scripts, and ad-hoc reports. This ticket scopes a product-led orchestration ("tenant residency contractor") that: 1) exposes a single source-of-truth residency declaration for each tenant; 2) surfaces retention TTLs and region pin choices in the Console and API; 3) composes a signed evidence bundle (proofpack) with request traces, retention changes, and certificate of region assignment for legal/audit teams; and 4) provides a lightweight API for programmatic attestations and automated scheduled exports.
acceptance_criteria: Console: new 'Residency' tab on tenant settings with region pin selector, retention TTL slider, and justification text field
API: POST /tenants/:id/residency accepts region_pin, retention_days, justification and returns a deployment token and a timeline id
Evidence: 'proofpack' generator compiles tenant declaration, last 90 days of endpoint routing events, SRE attestation, and retention change audit trail into a signed ZIP with metadata manifest
Audit export: ability to schedule monthly evidence exports to S3/GDrive with configurable retention on export
Telemetry: Console and API surfaces per-tenant proofpack generation time and proofpack size; alerting if proofpack generation fails >0.1% of attempts
Security: proofpacks include KMS-signed manifest; only users with 'residency-admin' role may generate or revoke declarations
out_of_scope: On-prem 'Private' product packaging for evidence exports (handled under PM-75017), deep legal contract negotiation workflow
tradeoffs_considered: Store full routing trace vs. compact event-summaries: chose compact summaries with ability to attach raw traces for high-risk customers to limit storage costs
Tight API validations vs. quick UX: allow draft declarations in Console but require API-signature for final attestation
Synchronous proofpack generation vs async: implement async generation with immediate receipt and webhook on completion to support large exports
risks: Proofpack generation can be large for active tenants leading to longer preparation windows
Mis-declared region pin could lead to compliance incidents if not surfaced clearly during changes
Cross-service dependency (routing telemetry, billing, KMS) increases rollout velocity risk
implementation_notes: Backend: create residency service (read-only data-model surfaced to Console) + job that composes proofpacks using existing routing-telemetry pipeline
KMS: use existing customer KMS integration path; proofpack manifest signed by platform KMS and optionally by customer KMS when bound
DB: retention_policy table linked to tenant with effective_from/effective_to fields for history
API contract: draft in docs link; add tenant scope and residency-admin role checks
design_considerations: UX confirms region consequences (show sample data routing map) before finalizing pin
Provide 'change impact preview' that simulates routing percentages pre/post pin change
Include a lightweight wizard for legal teams to append notes and attach external contracts to the proofpack
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Beta): internal + 5 pilot tenants with proofpack UI and API, async generation, manual SRE review
Phase 2: widen to 200 tenants, add scheduled exports and S3 sink
Phase 3: GA with role-based controls, retention enforcement automation, and public docs
metrics_for_success: >90% of pilot tenants successfully generate proofpack within 10 minutes
Reduction in manual compliance requests for residency evidence by 75% in first 90 days
